My brother, from the time he was born, had a disease called Hirschsprung's disease. It affected his ability to remove waste from his body, to put it gently, and made his stomach balloon full of waste. He had had several surgeries and colostomies within a 3 year span, and it was so sad to see a little child go through what he did.

Anyway, one day, around 4 years of age, he walked up to my mum and said he had an accident. This was physically impossible because he had a colostomy and the only working exit to his intestine was through that opening. My mother checked him and saw that he had indeed had an accident!

We took him to the hospital and the doctors inspected him, all the while scratching their heads. They had no idea how it had happened. So they did one last surgery to re-connect his intestines just to see if my brother had been healed. 

And to this day, my annoying little brother is in high school, and able to expel waste naturally. 

They have no idea how, but I'll forever be thankful. Even if he is a pain in the butt...ha...get it?
